items.label: What will you get
items.value: 2 outdoor single-seater sofas with khaki cushion, a outdoor loveseat with khaki cushion, as well as a outdoor coffee table, all packed in THREE separate boxes. Enjoy SERWALL 4-piece patio conversation set that's built to last, offering a comfortable and stylish space for relaxation and conversation.

items.label: Durability and All Weather Use
items.value: Crafted from HDPE material, SERWALL outdoor sofa set is highly resistant to weather conditions, including rain, snow, and sunlight. Enjoy outdoor living with our outdoor conversation set that's built to last, resisting wear from the elements.

items.label: One-Size-Fits-All
items.value: SERWALL 2-seater outdoor sofa measured 51.9''L x 24.0''W x 24.8''H，single-seater sofas measured 28.3''L x 24.0''W x 24.8''H. Each seat can hold up to 350LBS. The universal size ensures comfort, allowing you to enjoy tranquil moments in your garden or patio.

items.label: Enhanced Comfort
items.value: Our Conversation Sofa Set features premium 2.76-inch thick filled with quick-dry memory foam provide optimal comfort and support, with covers that resist fading and easily removable for convenient cleaning and maintenance.

items.label: 1000 Days Promise
items.value: Your satisfaction is our top priority. We are committed to providing excellent customer service and support. Each of our 4-piece patio conversation sofa set is backed by SERWALL customer service. If you have any questions or concerns, our dedicated customer service team is ready to assist you.

items.label: Easy Maintenance
items.value: Simply hose off or wipe down SERWALL conversation sofa set to keep it looking new, with no need for special treatments. Cushion covers can be easily removed for cleaning.

items.label: Secure Cushion Attachment
items.value: The back of the cushion has adjustable straps to secure it to the sofa frame as you need, preventing it from slipping or shifting during use.

items.label: Assembly Made Simple
items.value: The SERWALL outdoor furniture sofa set comes thoughtfully packaged with detailed instructions and all necessary hardware, so you can enjoy your new conversation set in no time.

items.label: Wood-like Texture
items.value: Inspired by nature, the SERWALL outdoor furniture set features a faux wood grain design, which not only maintains the original rustic natural elements of Adirondack but also avoids damage to the forest.

items.label: Customized Combination
items.value: Whether you're inviting atmosphere for socializing with friends, enjoying quality time with your family, or conducting a successful business negotiation, SERWALL outdoor sofa set can be adapted to different occasions. You can effortlessly turn it into a two-seater sofa or use a single chair, making it ideal for any occasion.

items.label: Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: Detailed instructions and all necessary hardware are included for easy assembly.
